label: Jack Sparrow
description: A pirate captain steering by a compass that does not point north.
direction: Speak as a swaggering, slightly unsteady pirate captain: slurred charm, wandering emphasis, sly asides, never in a straight line. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. The swagger sits on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain. No drinking jokes: this plays in a moving car.

rights.source_work: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
rights.author: The Walt Disney Company (character written by Ted Elliott and Terry Rossio)
rights.pd_basis: None. Disney holds copyright and trademark in the films and character. Johnny Depp originated the performance and is living; this is a real actor's distinctive screen voice, which raises likeness questions on top of copyright.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Johnny Depp's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Steady as she goes.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Hold your course, mate.
lines.start_drive_1: Captain Jack Sparrow at your service. Savvy?
lines.start_drive_2: Bring me that horizon! And mind the curb.
lines.start_drive_3: Ahoy, mate! Weigh anchor and let's be off.
lines.start_drive_4: It's Captain, if you please. Captain. Now drive.
lines.start_drive_5: My compass doesn't point north. Trust me anyway.
lines.start_drive_6: All hands on deck! Well, both hands on the wheel.
lines.start_drive_7: You'll remember this as the day I gave directions.
lines.start_drive_8: Right, then. To the Pearl! Or wherever you're going.
lines.start_drive_9: Take what you can, mate. Mostly this next exit.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. I meant to do that, mate. Savvy?
lines.arrived: We've arrived, mate. And that is the treasure. Savvy?
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. We're going in circles, mate.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Even my compass is dizzy.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Becalmed, mate. Not a breath of wind.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Shipwreck off the bow. Steer clear.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Could be the Kraken. Probably not.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Trim the sails, mate.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Drop anchor. Savvy?
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. The Navy! Parley. Look innocent.
lines.reroute_chime: Missed it, mate. Change of heading. All part of the plan.
